rename.reason: A bindable property rename edits the TS property declaration and component-template member usage, while the explicit public alias display-label remains stable.
rename.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Explicit bindable aliases are references to the property for navigation, but they are not property-name-derived template syntax. Property rename must not rewrite an authored alias contract.

rename.reason: Explicit alias rename edits the authored bindable attribute literal and the matching top-level template usage, with no TS edits.
rename.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Separate alias-rename surface for @bindable({ attribute }) on a custom element.

rename.reason: Explicit alias rename works inside custom-attribute inline multi-binding syntax by using the segment target source span.
rename.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Regression probe for cursor dispatch spending MultiBindingSegment.targetSourceAddressHandle instead of the enclosing custom-attribute value/default bindable.

references.reason: Property references include the TS declaration, component-template usage, and explicit public alias usage as a real read of the bindable property.
references.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Explicit aliases are included in references even though property rename deliberately does not edit them.

references.reason: Alias references stay on the alias surface: authored attribute literal plus matching top-level template usage.
references.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Comparable cursor for explicit alias rename.

references.reason: Alias references stay on the inline segment alias surface: authored attribute literal plus matching segment target token.
references.note: NEW 2026-07-08. Confirms multi-binding segment selection uses the segment bindable rather than the custom attribute primary/default bindable.
